markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (86%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Blur (severity 3) flags reliability [F6], leaving Benign vs Normal unseparated [F1]; margins deferred, recut/levels drafted.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 86%, Normal 7%, InSitu 6%, Invasive 1% | Favors Benign; 1% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90% coverage target) | Cannot separate Benign from Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% (flagged) / 100% OOD | Suspect input; severe blur artifact |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (top-class disagreement) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 1/5 Benign (20%), 4/5 Normal [F5] | Reference neighbors mostly Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.03, contribution -0.57) [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 6, 11) · context · Above-typical (1.01, contribution -0.45); 8/20 spotcheck [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.31, contribution -0.33); 0/20 spotcheck [F4] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 2, 10) · ↓ invasive · High text score (1.18, contribution -0.32) · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · High score (1.21, contribution -0.31); 20/20 spotcheck · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test set (deletion drop +0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020 excludes 0; n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); uses unreliable mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20), normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Blur (severity 3, 100% OOD) masks atypia, or superior margin (69% score) holds unsampled lesion [F7].
- Tissue is Normal breast, matching 4/5 nearest neighbors (84%–86% similarity, BACH_0297) and foundation-model disagreement.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 8**: Verify benign stroma/lobules vs Normal tissue; consider drafted recut H&E or deeper levels.
2. **Regions 1, 2, 7, 10**: Inspect tubules and ducts to separate Benign proliferation from Normal lobules.
3. **Regions 0, 6, 11**: Check superior margin in region 0 (69% score; defer call) and lymphoid foci.
